text:
170 Hispanic students enrolled at Creative Montessori Academy in 2024-25
Creative Montessori Academy enrolled 170 Hispanic students in the 2024-25 school year, a 4.9% increase from the previous year, according to the Michigan Department of Education.
Records show Creative Montessori Academy enrolled 759 students in the 2024-25 school year. Hispanic students made up 22.4% of the student body, the third-largest group. White students were the largest group, accounting for 38.9% (295) of the student body.
The school is in the Creative Montessori Academy School District, whose central office is in Southgate.
Creative Montessori Academy was the only school in the district to enroll Hispanic students, welcoming 170 in the 2024-25 school year.
Michigan’s 2026 education budget totals $24.1 billion, including $19.5 billion from the School Aid Fund. It set per-pupil funding at $10,050, a 4.6% increase from the previous year. The budget kept free school meals and provided full funding for pre-K and community college.
